description: x402-fetch: Fetch a page by URL with one HTTP request: raw HTML, HTTP status and extracted links, SSRF-protected. Not a rendered browser view. html is capped at 50,000 characters and links at 50 — htmlTruncated/returnedHtmlChars and linksTruncated/returnedLinks report whether and how much; linkCount is the total found. Set raw to false to drop the body. 🆓 5 free trial calls per signed wallet
name: x402-fetch
